info.name: Aghanim Server-to-Server Achievements Price Points API

params.name: country
params.description: The two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for price localization.

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale for price formatting (e.g., en, pt-BR, zh-Hant).

params.name: platform
params.description: Platform for platform-specific pricing (e.g., ios, android, any).

items.docs:
Returns price points from price templates for the specified country.

Price templates can be configured in Dashboard -> SKU Management ->
[Price Templates](https://dashboard.aghanim.com/go/sku/price-templates).

The `locale` parameter is optional and if not provided, it will be resolved
from the country with the best match available for that country.
